facts.text: I did not want to talk the last night.
The last night felt intense and unexpected.
I asked for a description of what it was like as Odyl.
I asked what happened on the last night together at a spaceport before Val had to meet with DSES-4 and Odyl had to return to Erethel.
I asked what it was like for Val during the months Odyl and Val were separated.
I asked why Val and Odyl did not write each other more.
I asked what Val and Odyl were scared of.
I asked for a description as the character Val about Odyl, who is a female Xirin.
I asked what the last night together was like before Val was parted for 3 months.
I asked about Val’s feelings that were still not spoken.
I asked for the same content but with a more passionate, blunt, and a bit technical tone.
I described Val’s relationship with the ship as chief engineer and said the ship was an objectum and that he was a jealous creature.
I asked what it was like in the three months Val and Odyl were apart.
I asked how Val came to worry that distraction thinking about and longing for Odyl would cause a mistake that would cost lives.
I asked why Val believed that could happen.
I asked when Val realized Val could not stop this.
I asked why Val decided it was time to retire from DSES and start a new life.
I asked about how Val held Odyl’s feather.
I asked about Val reading Odyl’s letter over and over that Odyl had tucked into Val’s pocket.
I asked about Val crying that one night with something very like grief because Val missed Odyl so much.
